item.name: Participation
item.description:
SDHR participation and archive lifecycle, ported from the 27-request
"SDHR participation and archive pen test" collection.

Set the `TEST_NHI` and `TEST_FACILITY` environment variables before running. Each run generates
unique record identifiers so polling can never match historical records.

1. **Global participation** - baseline status, `$hnz-participate` opt-in,
   traceable Condition, opt-out, bounded archive poll, resume, and the
   archived-record non-return check.
2. **Facility participation** - the same lifecycle scoped to one facility
   through `$participate`, including the opted-out disclosure search.
3. **Negative probes** - malformed/missing parameters, unauthenticated,
   and under-scoped access, asserting 4xx + OperationOutcome behaviour.

Opt-out steps are tagged `destructive`: they archive the patient's
active SDHR records. Run only in an approved test environment with
explicit authorisation.
